schema: br-kp1in.13 / br-kp1in.19 ab18 SP + L2 + L3 vs main v1
rule:
ab18: archive drain and reservation-artifact durability on main. Candidate = SP + L2 + L3, vs main. DRAFT, written before any ab18
build or run. The base commit and arm hashes are filled in when the br-tsqvm fix lands, before the first run, and the file then gets a
FROZEN line.

DISCLOSED CONTEXT. Everything below was seen before this rule.
- ab16 (SP vs main 8e912cc1) was a LOSS on its primary: the soak WBQ 10 s window failed for SP.
- In smoke 1 the post-swarm un-archived counts were 7,330 for base and 8,656 for SP. The soak convergence check failed in both arms.
- Paced diagnostics on main (draindiag, draindiag2):
  - the WBQ is 4,000-5,000 deep at the end of a run, with a 67 s p50 lag;
  - message batches average 2.3 messages, because bundles for several projects interleave with other ops;
  - the drain thread spends 79% of its time in fsync waits (jbd2) and 11% in futex waits;
  - about 2,400 release-artifact retries per run flood the WBQ. They exist because direct reservation writes are refused by the
    zero-wait fence admission: about 91% of grants on base, about 66% with SP.
- Since fdece065 (on base), a refused synchronous grant/renew publication is no longer a WARN plus a successful lease. The
  tool returns RESERVATION_ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE ("Do NOT edit the requested paths"). DirectArchiveWrite::Failed covers
  fence-busy LockContention (storage lib.rs write_op_sync_direct_with_cancel). The WARN line PA counts is still emitted,
  and on base each refusal should now also be a file_reservation_paths tool error. No ab18 data has been seen.
- ab17 (L2) was withdrawn before running because both of its arms carried br-tsqvm. That bug latched durability in 1 of about 15
  paced runs (6,743 errors).

ARMS (portable release, same host, host lock):
- base = main 2b5d14d7 + tsqvm_v1.patch (229c4d79), worktree rc1020f, crates diff hash af51a3426ded. The br-tsqvm commit pushed
  to main must have `git diff 2b5d14d7 <commit> -- crates` hashing to the same value. Build: build36/ab18b_base.
- cand = base + SP (parallel bundle staging) + L2 (bounded 500 ms direct fence admission) + L3 (per-archive grouping of bundles
  within a drained pass). Patch spl2l3_v1_combined.patch (911983f3), which applies to base with offsets only. Worktree rc1020e,
  crates diff hash eb58308263cd. Build: build36/ab18b_cand.
- Provenance per arm: the build log diff hash, am sha256, and the SP marker string "archive staging worker panicked" present
  in cand and absent in base.
- Not used: build36/ab18_cand (fdece065 + tsqvm + spl2l3, am 2470db8e). Main had moved 8 commits by the time it finished,
  including 757d309a, which changes reservation publication in storage lib.rs (the PA path).

RUNS: as in ab16 (load gate < 8, foreign-CPU validity, re-queue up to 6 h).
- P2: base cand cand base base cand.
- P6: cand base base cand.
- Release smoke in both orders (cand_vs_base, base_vs_cand).
- The paced server env adds RUST_LOG=info,mcp_agent_mail::storage::archive::batch_write=info with AM_ALLOW_DEBUG_STARTUP_LOGS=1, for
  batch-size reporting. It is the same in both arms.

PRIMARY. Both must hold.
- PA (reservation artifacts reach the archive the guard reads): pooled valid P2 and P6, grant-time refusals ("WARN reservation
  archive write ... synchronous reservation archive write failed") per 1,000 file_reservation_paths calls, for cand, are <= 10% of
  base's rate AND <= 50.
- PB (the archive keeps up with the mail; the br-kp1in.13 probe): in EACH smoke order, cand passes the soak check "WBQ drained_total
  advances in every 10s window with queued work" AND the soak check "archive converges after load stops", with soak sends >= 4000.

GUARDS (any failure = LOSS):
- G1 throughput: P2 completion median cand <= 1.05x base; smoke swarm acked sends cand >= 0.95x base in each order.
- G2 failures:
  - swarm 30 s timeouts cand <= base + 5 in each order;
  - smoke tool errors (swarm + soak) <= base + 5 in each order;
  - paced errors <= base + 5 (P2) and <= base + 3 (P6);
  - cand crash phase PASS;
  - integrity_check ok;
  - dispatch zombies for cand == 0 or <= base's, in each order;
  - no "canonical message id ... already exists" error in any cand server log.
- G3 latency below saturation:
  - P6 send p99 and last-60 s send p90 cand <= 1.2x base;
  - P6 file_reservation_paths p99 and release p99 cand <= base + 0.5 s;
  - every P6 completion <= 330 s.
- G4 reads: smoke soak reads cand >= 0.90x base and soak fetch_inbox p99 <= 1.3x base, in each order.
- G5 convergence: post-swarm un-archived cand <= base + 2% of cand's acked swarm sends, in each order.
- C gate on cand:
  - storage lib nextest (the only allowed failure is br-3ukrb's pre-existing test, failing identically on base);
  - storage + tools clippy -D warnings;
  - workspace prodcheck (lib+bins);
  - tools it and conformance.

REPORTED, not gated:
- P2 send p50/p90, with the closed-loop caveat (see ab16_rule.txt "GATE DEFECT");
- end-of-run WBQ depth and lag;
- messages per batch;
- release-artifact refusals;
- reservation p50/p99;
- paced tool errors per tool, especially file_reservation_paths and renew (the fdece065 user-visible effect).

DECISION:
- WIN only if PA, PB, G1-G5 and C all hold.
- A WIN lands SP+L2+L3 with this rule, the evidence and ab16's integrity split cited. It is reported to the owner, who can revert.
  SP's earlier vetoes came from the saturated-send-latency guard replaced in ab16_rule.txt. The primaries here are the bead
  probes, not that guard.
- LOSS: one line on br-kp1in.13 and br-kp1in.19; nothing lands.

FROZEN 2026-10-20T23:42Z, before any ab18 run (no ab18 directory exists).
- base am sha256 3d35263d06e664f345572b9175c7102d445ba6e87b0ccf11a1ca491f5401e254 (build36/ab18b_base; log diff=af51a3426ded;
  SP marker absent). Tree = 2b5d14d7 + local fix commit 62b93dc6, whose `git diff 2b5d14d7 62b93dc6 -- crates` hashes
  af51a3426ded. The pushed commit id is appended after the push; the tree hash stays the check.
- cand am sha256 af441f8dc875fad44a9b1da5c6b85e73b58d7616fa618a54e24454dd59eed32b (build36/ab18b_cand; log diff=eb58308263cd;
  SP marker present). Patches: tsqvm_v1.patch 229c4d79 + spl2l3_v1_combined.patch 911983f3.
- Gate and threshold edits after this line are not allowed. Data-free corrections (a path or a parser bug) get an appended,
  dated note that names what changed.
